assertions.name: bare_markov_F_3_NOT_equal_to_framework_F_3
assertions.source: bare-Markov ε^6 = -63/256 ≈ -0.246; framework F_3 = -2·b³(q=1) = -3√3/4 ≈ -1.299. Different by ~5×. The Q_β precision-ladder F_n are not the bare-Markov Taylor coefficients.

description: F_n categorical derivation probe via canonical Markov trace of σ_1² (Hopf+ braid). Confirms Markov-invariance across H_n for n=3-6; verifies the closed form tr_M(σ_1²) = 1 + (q-1)·q^(-1/2); verifies the C(-1/2, k-1) binomial pattern in the ε^k Taylor coefficients; SHOWS the bare-Markov coefficients DO NOT equal the framework's claimed F_n values, surfacing the open work on which categorical object actually produces each F_n.
caveats: This probe does NOT derive F_n from the canonical Markov framework. It surfaces the GAP between bare-Markov tr_M(σ_1²) Taylor coefficients and the framework's claimed F_n values. A genuine F_n derivation requires identifying which categorical object β_n produces each F_n factor — specifically for F_3, PR #657 Track-C's claim is V_(2,2,2) channel inside Hoefsmit V_(2,1)⊗V_(2,1) in H_6. This probe does not perform that projection — that's the genuine derivation work pending.
